outcome: knowledge and attitudes towards childbirth methods and complications
cohort: 500 women of reproductive age (18-45) in Al-Baha, Saudi Arabia, who had given birth vaginally or via cesarean section within the past five years
finding: The study found a preference for vaginal delivery among the women surveyed, with varying levels of knowledge about childbirth and postpartum complications based on education level and preferred childbirth method.
mod_finding: Women who preferred cesarean section displayed lower knowledge levels about childbirth complications.
